Vet Gods Academy

Learn every operation in order. No prior surgical knowledge is expected.

The Complete Operation Order

1 · Understand the Patient

Read the story, age, temperament and risk. This tells you why the operation is needed.

2 · Build the Plan

Choose staff, instruments, anesthesia style and recovery destination. Recommended Plan does this for you.

3 · Stabilize

Connect monitoring and keep oxygen, blood pressure and temperature in safe game ranges.

4 · Prepare

Sterile preparation reduces contamination. The yellow marker shows the next required area.

5 · Perform the Repair

Select the named tool and follow the glowing guide. Each operation has its own sequence.

6 · Recover and Review

Move the patient to recovery, respond to needs, then review your detailed performance grade.

Control Guide

Gold flash
Look here or press this next.
Yellow ! marker
A new event or change happened.
Green monitor
Patient values are stable.
Red status
Use Stabilize Patient or follow the explanation.

Plain-Language Dictionary

Anesthesia

Keeps the patient unconscious and comfortable during the fictional operation.

Sterile

Prepared to reduce contamination.

Hemorrhage

Serious bleeding that must be controlled.

Retractor

A tool that holds the operation field open for visibility.

Clamp

A tool used in the game to control a bleeding source.

Suction

Clears fluid so the team can see the operation field.

Animal guardians battle the disease titan whenever you build a safe-action streak.

Veterinary Equipment Catalog

Optional Amazon searches for general supplies, professional tools, recovery equipment, books, and veterinary-formulated herbal products.

Safety: Surgical blades and instruments are for trained veterinary professionals and simulation reference—not home procedures. Herbs and supplements can harm animals or interact with medicines; use only with a licensed veterinarian’s approval.
